title: 退距深度按墙高计算

derive.H: 墙高：室外地面至墙顶或墙与屋面覆盖层交线，垂直于墙面量；坡度 ≤ 70° 的屋面高度按 1/3 计入，≥ 70° 全部计入
derive.d: 外墙到地块边界的垂直距离
derive.zone: 用地性质（一般 / 商业或工业）

requirement: 一般地区 d ≥ 0.4 × H 且 ≥ 3 m；商业、工业区 d ≥ 0.2 × H 且 ≥ 3 m；建筑等级 1、2 且地上不超过三层时 3 m 即可；退距须在本地块内（可延伸到公共道路、绿地、水域的中线）

basis.quote: According to the model building regulations (MBO), it is 0.4 × H, but at least 3 m (0.2 × H, min. 3 m for commercial and industrial areas). In front of the outside walls of building classes 1 and 2 with not more than three overground storeys, 3 m depth is also sufficient.
Wall height means the dimension from ground level to upper extent of the wall or to the intersection of the wall with the roof covering
The height of roofs with a pitch of ≤70° is included to one third, ≥70° fully with the wall height
Setback areas must be on the plot itself

ifc_needed: IfcSite 地块边界（IFC 里通常没有，学生模型多半缺）
notes: 学生模型一般没有地块边界，只能算出 H 和所需退距，判定留空。

title: 办公楼朝向与北向房间

match.space.window_orientation: 房间采光面朝向（需 IfcSite TrueNorth）

derive.has_corridor: 平面是否为走廊式（单排 / 双排）

requirement: 北向办公室只在无走廊式平面中可接受；长轴东西向可避免早晚低角度阳光干扰、南向易用遮阳（美国 90% 的办公楼如此），按 Joedicke 则长轴南北向以保证所有房间都有日照

basis.quote: North-facing rooms are acceptable only for layouts without a corridor.

According to Rosenauer, 90% of all office buildings in the USA have a main axis E/W, because the deeply penetrating morning and evening sun is a disturbance. Sun from the south can be shaded more easily with sun blinds.

notes: 书中两种朝向说法并存（Rosenauer 东西 / Joedicke 南北），只有“北向房间仅限无走廊平面”是明确的判定句。

title: 单排、双排、三排平面与建筑类型

derive.layout: 按每层房间相对走廊/核心的排数判断：single-row / two-row / three-row（中部暗区设服务核心）

requirement: 双排是行政办公楼的标准解，单间和小办公室都能自然采光；单排不经济、不生态，只有办公室很深时可接受；三排（中部大服务区）通常只对高层合适

basis.quote: Two-row layouts have mostly been used for administration buildings until now; single rooms and small offices are possible with daylight
Single-row layouts are unecological, and only acceptable with deep office rooms (daylight?)
Single-row layout is normally uneconomical
A large supply zone at the centre of the building is normally practical only for high-rise buildings (greater proportion of vertical transport).

ifc_needed: IfcSpace 平面布置（推断排数）
notes: fantasy_office_building_1 是两条办公长条夹一个中庭，不属于三种之一；规则要允许 “atrium” 作为第四种结果。

title: 网格模数：装修网格 = 立面网格，1.50 / 1.35 m

derive.facade_module: 立面竖梃间距（IfcCurtainWall / IfcWindow 轴距）
derive.fitout_module: 隔墙可接驳位置的间距

requirement: 装修（隔墙）网格必须与立面网格一致，隔墙才能接到窗上（must）；结构网格可以与装修网格错开；模数宜取单间办公 1.50 m、组合办公 1.35 m（should）；1.50 m 模数下工位进深 2.20 m（桌 0.80 + 活动 1.00 + 后柜 0.40），含 10 cm 墙厚得 4.40 m 净房间；1.35 m 模数下 3.80 m 开间（约 18 m²）能布置所有常见工位

basis.quote: The fitting out and façade grids must be the same in order to enable the partitions to connect to the windows.
The structural grid can be offset against the fitting out grid. This reduces the problem of connecting the partitions to columns, but loses space in the rooms, which contain columns.
The modular dimensions, which have proved successful in recent years, are 1.50 m for single-room offices and 1.35 m for office types based on the combi principle.
Workstation depth 2.20 m (80 cm desk, 1 m movement area, 40 cm shelf behind). With 10 cm wall thickness, this gives 4.40 m clear room space.
Room widths of 3.80 m (~18 m^2 usable area) enable:

ifc_needed: IfcCurtainWall 竖梃 IfcMember 的间距
IfcWall 隔墙端点与竖梃位置
notes: fantasy_office_building_1 的幕墙类型叫 “Fassade:Raster 1.5 x 3.0m”，模数 1.50 可直接从类型名读出。

title: 中廊式办公楼的建筑进深

derive.depth: 建筑进深（垂直于走廊方向的外墙间距）

requirement: 中廊式办公楼通常进深 12–13 m；网格 1.35 m 配进深 13.40 m 对组合办公经济、对单间办公则房间过深；网格 1.50 m 配进深 12.50 m 对单间或组合办公都经济，但公共区窄、靠窗工位少 10%

basis.quote: The usual depth of buildings with central corridors is 12–13 m.
Grid module 1.35 m, building depth 13.40 m, an economical form of building for combi-offices, but for single offices this produces deep and badly proportioned rooms.

Grid module 1.50 m, building depth 12.50 m, an economical form of building for single offices or for combi-offices; this provides a narrow communal zone and 10% fewer workstations at the window than with ②.

title: 每工位的附属面积与总面积

derive.a_by_function: 各功能房间净面积之和 / n_ws：卫生、会议、档案、储藏、餐饮、入口、收发、机房、交通

basis.quote: Workstation | Immediate workstation | 11–15 | 13 | 15.5
Subsidiary areas | Sanitary facilities | 0.6–0.8 | 0.7
| Conference/training | 0.3–1.0 | 0.6
| Canteen, cafeteria, tea kitchen | 0.6–1.6 | 1.1 | 9.0
| Entrance area | 0.2–0.7 | 0.4
Building | Construction area | 1.9–3.8 | 3.0 | 10.5
| Traffic area | 2.2–6.0 | 4.5
| Server room | 0.5–1.5 | 1.0 |
| Building services | 2.4–4.6 | 3.0 |
The total space requirement per workstation varies between 23 and 45 m^2, depending on organisational and status requirements.

notes: 与 R09 的区别：R09 是单个房间口径，这里是整栋楼口径。

title: 防火分区 ≤ 40 m 与防火墙

derive.compartment_walls: 标为防火墙的 IfcWall（FireRating ≥ F 90, 不燃）

requirement: 须设防火墙把建筑划成不超过 40 m 的防火分区；距地块边界 < 2.50 m 的外墙须为防火墙；防火墙须 F 90 A（防火、受火稳定、不燃），从基础连续到屋面以上 ≥ 30 cm（软屋面和工业建筑 ≥ 50 cm）；防火墙上原则上不开口，建筑内部的防火墙可开口但须自闭防火门 T 90

basis.quote: According to the MBO, fire compartment walls are to be constructed in the following locations: the external walls of buildings, when the wall is less than 2.50 m from the plot boundary; between terraced buildings on the same plot boundary; and to sub-divide larger buildings into fire compartments of not more than 40 m.

Fire compartment walls must be fireproof, structurally stable when exposed to fire and consist of non-combustible materials (F 90A). They must normally extend continuously from the foundations to min. 30 cm above the roof (min. 50 cm for a soft roof covering and in industrial buildings) or be capped with a projecting slab

Openings in fire compartment walls are generally impermissible. They can be allowed through fire compartment walls within buildings and then have to be provided with fireproof self-closing doors (T 90 door or gate)

ifc_needed: IfcZone 防火分区（模型都没有）
notes: fantasy_office_building_1 长 32 m < 40 m，不触发；学生模型 FireRating 几乎都为空。

title: 建筑等级决定承重构件与楼板的耐火要求

match.building.class: 建筑等级 1–5（住宅超过两套或使用面积 ≥ 400 m² → 等级 3–5；等级 1、2 ≤ 三层地上）

derive.is_basement: 构件所在楼层低于室外地面

requirement: 承重及支撑墙、柱：等级 5 防火（fireproof）、等级 4 高度阻燃、等级 1–2 阻燃；地下室内须防火（等级 1–2 阻燃）；楼板须防火或至少阻燃，地下室顶板须防火；有耐火要求的楼板不得开洞，必须开洞时须用同等耐火的防火封堵

basis.quote: Load-bearing and bracing walls and columns must be constructed fireproof in buildings of class 5, highly fire-retarding in buildings of class 4 and fire-retarding in buildings of classes 1 and 2
In cellars, they have to be constructed fireproof and, in buildings of classes 1 and 2, fire-retarding.

Ceilings must be fireproof, or at least fire-retarding, and slabs over cellars must be fireproof. Openings in ceilings and floor slabs for which a fire resistance duration is necessary are prohibited. If openings are required, they must be fitted with fire protection closures (doors, etc.) constructed with a fire resistance duration corresponding to that of the slab.
In front of the outside walls of building classes 1 and 2 with not more than three overground storeys, 3 m depth is also sufficient.

ifc_needed: 建筑等级（IFC 无，按层数与面积推断）
notes: 建筑等级的完整定义书里没有，只有零散线索；对 5 层、1257 m² 的办公楼按等级 4/5 处理。

title: 外墙、外墙饰面与屋面覆盖的燃烧性能

derive.combustibility: 材料燃烧等级（Pset_*Common.Combustible 或材料类别）

requirement: 非承重外墙及承重外墙的非承重部分须用不燃（至少阻燃）材料（等级 1–3 除外）；外墙饰面含保温层和支撑构造须难燃（等级 1、2 若能防止向邻房蔓延可用普通可燃）；屋面一般须为“硬屋面”，抗飞火和辐射热

basis.quote: Non-load-bearing external walls and non-load-bearing parts of load-bearing external walls are (except for buildings of building classes 1–3) to be constructed of non-combustible (at least fire-retarding) materials. External wall claddings, including insulation and support construction, have to be made of flame-resistant materials.
The roofing must generally consist of 'hard covering' and be resistant against airborne spread of fire and radiated heat.

notes: 幕墙是“非承重外墙”，这条对 fantasy_office_building_1 的 38 片幕墙直接适用。

title: 每层每个使用单元两条独立疏散路线

match.unit.has_occupied_room: 单元内至少一个有人员停留的房间

derive.n_routes: 通往室外的独立疏散路线数
derive.first_via_stair: 第一条是否经必要楼梯（间）
derive.second: 第二条经第二部必要楼梯，或消防队救援设备可达的位置
derive.safety_stairwell: 是否为烟火不能侵入的安全楼梯间

requirement: 每层须有至少两条通往室外的独立疏散路线；单元不在地面层时第一条须经必要楼梯（必要时在自己的楼梯间内），第二条经第二部必要楼梯或消防队救援设备可达的位置；若经安全楼梯间疏散则不需要第二条

basis.quote: Residential or commercial units with at least one occupied room must have at least two independent escape routes leading to the open air on each storey.

the first escape route must be via a legally essential staircase, if required in its own (legally essential) stairwell, and the second escape route via a second essential staircase or a single unified location which is accessible with the rescue equipment of the local fire brigade
A second escape route is not required if escape is via a safety stairwell

ifc_needed: IfcZone 使用单元（无则按整层）
notes: fantasy_office_building_1 每层 2–4 部楼梯，第一个条件易判；“救援设备可达”要看窗。

title: 疏散距离按建筑类型：办公 ≤ 35 m，楼梯间距 30 / 60 m

match.building.type: office = “buildings without special status, according to LBO”

derive.d_max: 每个居室内任一点到最近必要楼梯间或室外出口的步行距离

requirement: 普通建筑（含办公）任一点到楼梯间 ≤ 35 m；高层 25 m；学校、商店、封闭/地下车库、人员密集场所、医院 30 m；实践中楼梯间距建筑端部约 30 m、彼此约 60 m；多部楼梯时布置使疏散路线最短；卫生间、楼梯间、电梯井等固定点按法规最大间距布置

basis.quote: Every location in inhabited rooms and basements must be \( \leq 35 \) m from the stairwell of at least one legally essential stairway or exit. If a number of stairways are necessary, then they should be arranged so that the escape route is as short as possible.
- high-rise buildings | 25 m
- buildings without special status, according to LBO | 35 m

According to MBO 2002, every point in an occupied room must be \( \leq 35 \) m from a staircase. This in practice leads to a spacing of the staircases from the end of the building of 30 m and from each other of 60 m
Fixed points are sanitary facilities, stairwells, lift shafts etc., situated at maximum spacings defined in the building regulations

title: 必要楼梯：封闭楼梯间、出口宽度、楼梯间开门

derive.enclosed: 楼梯是否位于连续封闭的楼梯间（IfcSpace 包围 + 墙）
derive.exit_to_open_air: 楼梯间出口是否直通室外或经无火荷载前室
derive.doors_into_stairwell: 开向楼梯间的门是否占用梯段宽度

requirement: 所有主楼梯须设在连续封闭的楼梯间内，连同通道和通向室外的出口能安全用于疏散；出口宽度与梯段宽度对应（原文 “Exit width should be ≤ stair width”）；开向楼梯间的门不得遮挡梯段宽度

basis.quote: All main staircases must be enclosed in a continuous stairwell, which is designed and arranged so that, including its access routes and exit to the open air, it can safely be used for escape. Exit width should be \( \leq \) stair width.
Doors opening into the stairwell must not obstruct the stair width.

ifc_needed: IfcStair 与包围它的 IfcSpace / IfcWall（需 IfcRelSpaceBoundary 或几何）
notes: fantasy_office_building_1 的楼梯都开敞在大厅/办公区里，没有楼梯间——这是对学生模型最常见的判定。

title: 必要楼梯的尺寸限值（非住宅）
requirement: 必要楼梯：w ≥ 100 cm，r ≤ 19 cm，t ≥ 26 cm；非必要（附加）楼梯：w ≥ 50 cm，21/21；常规楼梯 17/29，必要楼梯每 ≤ 18 步设平台；层高 3.00 m 对应两跑 18 步 r = 16.66 cm

basis.quote: Row | Type of building | Type of stairs | Usable stair width (min) | Stair riser (R)^2 | Stair tread (T)^3
4 | other buildings | legally essential stairs | 100 | 19 | 26
5 | all buildings | non-essential (additional) stairs | 50 | 21 | 21
Normal stairs 17/29, landing after max. 18 steps for legally essential stairs.

notes: 比 R05 的 17/28 更适合办公楼：这张表按建筑类型给出限值，办公楼属 “other buildings”。fantasy 的 r = 20 cm 超过 19。

title: 办公与疏散楼梯应便于快速通行；气派楼梯的平台豁免

match.stair.role: office stair / emergency stair / prestigious stair

derive.is_prestigious: 是否为门厅内的气派楼梯

requirement: 办公楼楼梯和疏散楼梯应便于快速上下（区别于宜用低踏步的室外楼梯）；气派楼梯可在层高 ≤ 4 m 时不设平台，平台要求对其放宽；无障碍建筑的楼梯踏步不得有突缘

basis.quote: Stairs in offices or emergency stairs should, in contrast, make it possible to change level quickly.
Prestigious-style stairs can climb up to a 4 m storey height without a landing.
For stairs intended to be prestigious the requirement to provide landings is mitigated.
For stairs in buildings subject to disability-friendly building rules, steps may have no nosing!

ifc_needed: IfcStair 所在 IfcSpace（门厅 → 气派楼梯）
notes: fantasy_office_building_1 大厅里的 Ortbetontreppe 可按气派楼梯看，但层高 4.8 > 4 m，豁免不成立；NosingLength = 0.03 也违反无突缘。

title: 无台阶通达所有楼层（公众可达建筑）

match.building.public_access: 办公、行政建筑属 MBO §50(2) 的公众可达建筑

derive.step_free_access: 每层是否可经电梯或坡道到达
derive.has_lift: IfcTransportElement ELEVATOR 存在且服务各层

requirement: 公众可达建筑面向公众的部分须能供残障人士、老人和带小孩者无需帮助进出使用；按无障碍原则设计的建筑所有楼层须无台阶可达（电梯或坡道）

basis.quote: Buildings which are publicly accessible, must in their parts serving the general public be capable of being accessed and used, according to their purpose, by disabled people, old people and people with small children, without outside help. This requirement applies notably to cultural, educational, sport, leisure and health facilities, offices, administration buildings and courts, sales and catering establishments, parking, garages and toilets.
All levels of buildings designed in accordance with the principles of accessibility must be accessible without steps, i.e. using a lift or a ramp.

notes: fantasy_office_building_1 五层没有任何 IfcTransportElement，直接 fail。

title: 无障碍电梯：轿厢与门前活动区

derive.overlap: 是否与其他交通路线/活动区重叠
derive.with_stair: 电梯是否与主楼梯间组合

requirement: 轿厢净宽 ≥ 1.10 m、净深 ≥ 1.40 m；门前活动区不小于轿厢地面面积且 ≥ 1.50 × 1.50 m，不得与其他交通路线和活动区重叠；电梯组通常与主楼梯间组合布置

basis.quote: Cars of lifts must have a min. clear width of 1.10 m and a clear depth of 1.40 m. The movement area in front of the doors must be as large as the floor area of the car, but min. 1.50 m wide and 1.50 m deep
This area must not overlap with other traffic routes and movement areas.
Lift sets normally form part of the main stairwell.

title: 无障碍坡道
requirement: 坡度 ≤ 6%；净宽 ≥ 1.20 m；超过 6 m 须设 ≥ 1.50 m 长的中间平台；起止处设平台；两侧扶手（高 85 cm，直径 3–4.5 cm）及 10 cm 轮挡；坡道延长线上不得有向下台阶

basis.quote: May have a maximum slope of 6% → 3. If ramps are longer than 6 m, an intermediate landing of min. 1.50 m length is required. The ramp and the intermediate landing are both to be provided with 10 cm high wheel kerbs and handrails (diameter 3–4.5 cm) at a height of 85 cm. The clear ramp width must be min. 1.20 m.
There must be no stairs down in the extension of the ramp.

Ramps may not have a slope of more than 6%, must be at least 1.20 m wide and have a fixed handrail with a safe grip on both sides. A landing is to be provided at the start and end of the ramp and also an intermediate landing every 6 m. The landings must have a length of at least 1.50 m.

notes: 9 个模型都没有 IfcRamp；规则仍保留，因为入口有高差时就会触发。

title: 使用单元 ≥ 400 m² 时走廊为必要走廊：侧墙 F 30

derive.is_essential_corridor: unit.area ≥ 400 m² 且走廊是居室到楼梯间/室外的疏散路线
derive.glazing_sill: 侧墙上采光玻璃下沿高度

requirement: 走廊受疏散路线规定约束：侧墙须阻燃 F 30；侧墙上的采光开口可用 G 级玻璃但下沿须 ≥ 1.80 m 离地；使用单元 < 400 m² 时走廊不受疏散路线要求

basis.quote: For combined use units of less than 400 m², the corridors are not subject to the requirements for escape routes.

A typical area of application for G-glazing is the openings for lighting installed in corridor walls, which have to be constructed fire-retarding (F 30) as the side walls of escape routes. The lower edge of the glass must in this case be at least 1.80 m above floor level, so that in case of fire the corridor remains usable in the radiation shadow.

title: 单元之间的分隔墙

match.wall.between_units: 墙两侧属于不同的使用单元（租户）或单元与其他用途房间

derive.storey_structure_rating: 该层承重构件耐火等级（R20）
derive.extends_to_slab: 墙是否砌到结构楼板（非仅到吊顶）

requirement: 分隔墙耐火时间须与该层承重构件相当；须一直到结构楼板（屋顶空间内到屋面覆层）；开口限于使用所需的大小和数量，并用至少阻燃、密闭、自闭的构件封闭

basis.quote: The fire resistance duration of separating walls between residential or commercial units (or units and rooms used otherwise) must correspond to the quality of the load-bearing components of the storey. These must extend to the structural slab (in roof spaces up to the roof cladding). Openings are limited to the size and number required for their use and must be closed by components which are at least fire-retarding, sealed and self-closing.

ifc_needed: IfcWall 顶标高 vs IfcSlab 底标高
notes: 出租办公（可逆办公楼）里每个租户单元都是一个 zone。

title: 工作场所厕所的布置细则

derive.n_wc: 一个厕所单元内的 WC 隔间数
derive.urinal_visible_from_entrance: 从入口是否直接看到小便器

requirement: 厕所单元 = 带洗手盆的前室（每 5 个 WC ≥ 1 个洗手盆）+ 完全分隔的 WC 间；一个单元不超过 10 个 WC 隔间和 10 个小便器；小便器不得从入口直接可见；隔间可上锁，轻质隔断高 ≥ 1.90 m、底部留 10–15 cm；所有卫生设施中至少一个轮椅厕所（并标识）；厕所、淋浴、更衣室的门须向外开

basis.quote: Toilet facilities consist of a lobby with washbasins (at least one washbasin per five WCs) and a completely separate room with at least one WC

Toilet cubicles must be lockable and, if light partitions (incompletely separated WC cubicles) are used, the partition should have a height of at least 1.90 m, and at the bottom a gap of 10–15 cm. Urinals must be placed so as not to be visible from the entrance. Toilet facilities should not contain more than 10 WC cubicles and 10 urinals.
At least one toilet must be provided for wheelchair users in all sanitary facilities.
Doors to toilets, showers and changing rooms must open outward.
One toilet must also be suitable and accessible for wheelchair users; this is to be indicated by a sign.

via the size of the workplace surroundings (max. 7.5 m to a window)
